line: That quick beige fox jumped in the air over each thin dog. Look out, I shout, for he's foiled you again, creating chaos.
mismatchEvaluatedOn: middle frame of each phone interval in both views
notes: Failing per-phone checks are results, not gate failures: no runtime tuning in this slice.
Bilabial mids seal in the default view's narrow central box (upper/lower 0) while the wide mouth-front box catches tooth slivers at the commissures; see the contact sheet and clip.mp4.
Mouth-front lowerTeethN reads 0 on every frame: the split seam lands below all visible teeth in this view, so arch attribution there is upper-only.
